scripts.e2e:serve: npm run db:migrate:local && npm run db:seed:local && npm run dev
scripts.db:migrate:local: WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/wrangler.log wrangler d1 migrations apply stayworth-mvp --local --config wrangler.local.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:remote: WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/wrangler.log wrangler d1 migrations apply stayworth-mvp --remote --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.cf:deploy: npm run build && WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/wrangler.log wrangler deploy --config wrangler.deploy.jsonc
scripts.cf:migrate:remote: WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/wrangler.log wrangler d1 migrations apply stayworth-mvp --remote --config wrangler.deploy.jsonc
scripts.cf:rows: WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/wrangler.log wrangler d1 execute stayworth-mvp --remote --config wrangler.deploy.jsonc --command "SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cities) AS cities, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hotels) AS hotels, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM price_snapshots) AS snapshots"
